summary: Catarina Croce of Dasa in Calabria, wife of Nicola Malvaso and mother of Domenica Malvaso; John's 5th-great-grandmother.
bio: Catarina Croce was born about 1742 at Dasa, Vibo Valentia, Calabria, Italy, and died there. She married Nicola Malvaso and was the mother of Domenica Malvaso. Through that line she was John's 5th-great-grandmother on his mother's side.
